latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Subtitle Generator YouTube — Generate and Embed YouTube Captions.

- Upload your YouTube video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and automatically generate and embed English subtitles.
- No need for professional editing software or manual transcription.
- Fast: Get captioned 1080p YouTube-ready videos in 30–60 seconds using cloud GPU processing.
- Simple workflow: Drag and drop your file, describe your editing needs, and download the finished video.
- Built-in credit system with anonymous token authentication (100 free credits, 7-day validity).
- Easily check upload status, export, and balance via clear chat prompts.
